subset.rationale: nlohmann::json = basic_json<>; the whole real value type is reflected (no facade). Value-ingestion/extraction is all member templates (correctly skipped), so jsontest helper factories supply populated inputs; the binder still exposes the real dump()/is_*()/size()/operator[]/== surface under test. Previously OUTCOME B: reflecting basic_json crashed clang-p2996 — originally mis-attributed to a constexpr/SLoc-exhaustion ceiling (TC-0002), but root-caused to a use-after-free in Sema (fixed in the pinned toolchain). With the fix + a raised constexpr-step budget, the real class binds.
skipped_features: all member templates: get<T>/parse/get_to/emplace_back/compat-ctors (Python uses jsontest factories instead)
